tools.file.changed.text: The file changed after your last Read. This includes changes made through Bash. Nothing was written. Call Read again, then retry.

tools.file.undecodable.text: This file starts with a UTF-16 byte order mark but is not valid UTF-16 text, so Edit cannot keep its other bytes. Nothing was written. Use Write to replace the whole file; its original bytes are saved first.

tools.file.original_not_saved.text: This file is not valid UTF-8 or UTF-16 text, and a copy of its original bytes could not be saved first, so nothing was written. Write to a new file instead, or change this one with a program that handles its actual encoding.

tools.file.write_original_saved.text: The previous file was not valid UTF-8 or UTF-16 text; its exact bytes are saved at {path}.

tools.file.edit_original_saved.text: Bytes outside the replaced text are unchanged; the file's exact previous bytes are saved at {path}.

tools.file.partial_write.text: {error}. Restoring the previous content also failed ({restore}), so the file may now be partially written. Inspect it before retrying.

tools.file.partial_new_file.text: {error}. A partially written file may remain at this path; inspect or remove it before retrying.

tools.file.replaced_during_write.text: Another program replaced or removed the file at this path during the write, so the path does not hold the written content. Read the file before retrying.

tools.file.edit_no_change.text: The replacement equals the matched text once the file's line endings are applied, so the file would not change. Nothing was written.

tools.file.read_undecodable.text: [This file is not valid UTF-8 or UTF-16 text; bytes that cannot be decoded are shown as U+FFFD (�). Edit replaces only the text it matches, and Edit and Write save a copy of the original bytes first.]

tools.file.read_incomplete_end.text: [The final UTF-8 character is incomplete and is not shown.]

tools.file.read_encoding.text: [Decoded from {encoding}; Edit and Write keep this encoding. Shell text tools such as grep and sed see its encoded bytes, not this text.]

tools.file.utf16_range.text: This {encoding} file exceeds the {limit} byte limit for decoded reads. Convert a copy to UTF-8 with a program, then read that copy in ranges.

tools.file.queued_change.text: The file changed while this write was waiting. Nothing was written by this call. Check the current file before retrying.

tools.file.edit_read.text: Edit needs a recorded Read of this file. Read the target, then prepare old_string from the returned source text and retry.

tools.file.write_limit.text: File exceeds the {limit} byte limit. Use Bash to process larger files with a program that streams them.

tools.file.regular_only.text: Only regular files can be read

tools.file.read_limit.text: File exceeds the {limit} byte read limit. Use Grep to search it, or Bash (for example tail or sed -n) to print a part of it.

tools.file.grew.text: File grew while being read. Obtain a fresh, complete view before changing this file.

tools.file.identical_edit.text: Edit rejected identical old_string and new_string values. Supply different replacement text, or omit this edit if no change is needed.

tools.file.empty.text: <system-reminder>This file is empty; there are no lines to display.</system-reminder>

tools.file.changed_after_edit.text: Note: the file changed again after this edit. Re-read it before further changes.

tools.file.refresh_failed.text: The read state could not be refreshed. Read the file again before further changes.

tools.file.invalid_offset.text: offset must be a nonnegative integer

tools.file.invalid_limit.text: limit must be a positive integer

tools.file.denied.text: Permission to read {path} has been denied.

tools.file.directory.text: {path} is a directory, not a file. Use Glob with this path to list its files (pattern "*", or "**/*" to include subfolders).

tools.file.beyond_end.text: <system-reminder>Requested line {offset} is beyond this file's {total} lines. Choose an offset within that range.</system-reminder>

tools.file.line_truncated.text: [Line {line} alone exceeds the {budget}; only its beginning is shown. offset and limit select lines, not positions within a line. An available file-processing tool may read smaller chunks of this line.]

tools.file.more_lines.text: [Showing lines {start}-{end} of {total}. Later lines are available from offset={offset}.]

tools.file.no_match.text:
Edit found no literal match for old_string. Read the target again and copy the intended passage with its original spaces, tabs, and line breaks; exclude displayed line numbers. No replacement was made.
Unmatched old_string: {old}

tools.file.ambiguous_edit.text:
The edit is ambiguous: old_string occurs {count} times. Include enough adjacent source text to select one occurrence, or set replace_all=true if every occurrence should change.
old_string: {old}

tools.file.image_invalid.text: Cannot attach image {path}: the file is empty, invalid, or incomplete. No image was attached. Use a valid PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP file.

tools.file.image_limit.text: Image file is too large ({megabytes} MB). Maximum supported size is 5 MB. Consider resizing or compressing the image before reading.

tools.file.image_unsupported.text: [Image file: {path}. This format cannot be delivered for visual analysis; convert it to PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP.]

tools.file.image_captured.text: [Image file: {path}. The image content has been captured for visual analysis.]

tools.file.pdf_guidance.text: No PDF text or images were extracted. Changing pages on Read will not extract contents. Use an available PDF-capable tool or a local text extractor; scanned pages need OCR.

tools.file.pdf_limit.text: PDF size is {size} bytes; Read accepts up to 104857600 bytes (100 MiB). {guidance}

tools.file.pdf_invalid_pages.text: Invalid PDF page selection: pages must be a string containing a positive safe integer or an ascending inclusive range, such as "2" or "2-4". {guidance}

tools.file.pdf_too_many_pages.text: Requested {count} pages; the selection limit is 20. Split the selection into ranges of at most 20 pages: start with "{start}-{end}", then continue from page {next}. {guidance}

tools.file.pdf_selection.text: Requested pages: {selection}. The document's page count has not been checked.

tools.file.state_key_type.text: File state keys must be strings

tools.file.state_property_type.text: File state property must be a string

tools.file.state_unavailable.text: External file read state is no longer available

tools.file.more_lines_unknown_total.text: [Showing lines {start}-{end}. More content remains; the total line count was not scanned. Later lines are available from offset={offset}.]

tools.file.end_of_file_not_start.text: [Showing lines {start}-{end}; end of file. Earlier lines are outside this view.]

tools.file.read_budget.text: [Read reached the {budget}; showing lines {start}-{end}{total_suffix}. This is a partial view. Later lines are available from offset={offset}; Grep can locate specific sections.]

tools.file.line_truncated_later.text: [Later lines start at offset={offset}; this does not include the omitted part of line {line}.]

tools.file.changed_during_read.text: [The file changed during this read. Lines {start}-{end} were captured, but they do not establish a stable view of the file.]

tools.file.read_cancelled.text: [Read was cancelled before a text range was delivered.]
